Debug experiment, parked use only. Start uses a published app shortcut. Hang up uses the current app-provided notification action. Neither confirms a conversation state. Permission prompts, including MCP, remain in the original app and are not detected or approved. No automatic start, retry or confirmation.
Review assistant role

Selecting Lautwerk temporarily replaces your digital assistant. Its assistant gesture does nothing and it does not provide speech recognition or hotword detection. This trial needs the active voice interaction role for shortcut access. Restore the previous assistant and its context settings after testing. Continue to Android settings?
Review notification access

Android grants broad notification access, not access to just two apps. This experiment filters ChatGPT and Claude, reads only control metadata, and never reads message text, titles, extras or MCP prompts. It retains current actions only in memory and sends Hang up only after your explicit press. Revoke access after testing. Continue to Android settings?
